# StudyFlick

> Practical guides, workflow benchmarks, and copyable prompt templates for college and computer science learners building reliable academic habits.

StudyFlick is an independent editorial publication maintained by Muhammad Sohaib (BSc Computer Science Student). Every guide focuses on grounded research, source-locked lecture synthesis, and disciplined software debugging without hype or paid placements.

## Site URLs

- [Home Playbook](https://sohaib007w.github.io/studyflick-blog/index.html): Overview of structured academic workflows, interactive app comparison matrix, editorial policy, and privacy statement.
- [Best AI Tools for College & CS Students](https://sohaib007w.github.io/studyflick-blog/best-ai-tools.html): Category breakdown across academic research, source-grounded notebooks, and coding assistants, including free university tiers.
- [How to Summarize Lecture PDFs & Research Papers](https://sohaib007w.github.io/studyflick-blog/summarize-pdfs.html): Five-step reading pipeline with three copyable prompt templates for claim matrices, slide glossaries, and active-recall self-testing.
- [How to Write & Debug Code with AI Prompts](https://sohaib007w.github.io/studyflick-blog/debug-code-ai.html): Four-part bug report structure, Socratic teaching-assistant prompts, edge-case test generation, and a six-point verification checklist.
